questions.text: Does DELETE /api/doctors/:id enforce the baseline rule that doctors with appointments are made Inactive, never deleted? If yes, Q-02 can be closed and S-4 moved to Known.

rubric_items.reason: Uses only existing modules, the existing route and the existing index. It follows the route/service/repo layering and the client.ts-only rule, with no new tables, jobs or endpoints.
S-1 to S-5 are all mapped to components. S-5 search and sort preservation depends on the unresolved Q-03 assumption, and only regression tests are offered for it.
Methods and paths are precise. The widened GET /api/patients item shape is not specified: no field names, types or null/empty representation for the next appointment (id, start, doctor name).

Claims are cited and unknowns are asked. But Q-02/S-4 stays assumed even though an input baseline already says doctors with appointments are made Inactive, never deleted. C17 cites a file not listed in the inputs.
Four trade-offs cover the in-query join vs per-patient call, widening vs a new endpoint, UTC comparison vs display zone, and keeping AppointmentRepo untouched.
Clear and consistent overall. One evidence line reference points to the wrong story line.
